display.stretch: Fixed DN0..3000 to0..255, display only; no thresholds/classification/resampling

limits: Raw native integer windows only; full remote COG objects not downloaded or whole-file authenticated.
Native10m reflectance and native20m SCL kept separately; SCL is a model mask, not independent water truth.
Original centres unchanged. No fitted shift, shoreline, cell classification, annual persistence, legal authority or hold clearance.
Range reads use existing GDAL with finite HTTP timeouts/cache; no aggregate network-byte enforcement claim.
preservation_scope: Exact Nha Trang20 subset of actual 33-centre/two-window operation; original execution receipt describes the whole original operation. No scientific replay or whole remote COG hash.
